jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original reusable illustration component for Design 2 Minchiate playing cards, designed to remain legible inside a 750 by 1050 Poker card. Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match the Design 2 fine warm outlines, softly shaded faces, luminous printed-silk surface, red phoenix robes, dark teal lotus embroidery, antique gold and small turquoise accents. Do not copy its two-way layout or its frame. This is contemporary card illustration inspired by Chinese silk and court dress, not a claim of historical reconstruction. One upright composition, restrained botanical base, balanced silhouette centered horizontally. Complete objects and extremities visible, 8 percent clear padding on every edge. TRUE transparent RGBA background with transparent interior gaps. No rectangle of paper, border, card panels, printed title, lettering, numeral, shadow, watermark, checkerboard or mockup. The figure will be typeset and framed separately. Image 2 supplies ONLY the Empress subject and attributes; replace its European costume and botanical style completely with the Design 2 visual language. Subject: THE EMPRESS, one adult East Asian woman seated full length on a compact gold-and-dark-teal throne, wearing madder-red phoenix-embroidered robes, a teal-and-gold shoulder stole and a compact gold/teal phoenix crown with pearls. One hand holds an upright slender lotus-tipped ceremonial scepter; the other rests naturally on the throne arm. Include one small round teal-and-gold shield bearing a clear Venus symbol at her feet, a few ripened grain stalks and a few lotus blossoms at the base. Warm composed expression. Flowing robes, coherent hands and anatomy. Composition compact enough for Poker width: entire throne and garments together form a centered roughly 2:3 portrait silhouette. No inverted duplicate figure. No European star crown, Renaissance dress or large surrounding floral field.
